earnings.title: For further information: TRADED: NYSE (IEX) EX-99.1
highlights: Reported diluted EPS of $1.95 and record adjusted diluted EPS of $2.33 both increased 15%
Operating cash flow as a percent of net income 166% 159% NM
Record sales of $952 million increased 8% on both a reported and organic basis
Returned $129 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases

quotes.text: We are pleased to report another strong quarter, with results ahead of our expectations. This quarter, we delivered both record sales and adjusted EPS while expanding margins and booked nearly $1 billion in orders.

outlook: Full year organic sales projected to increase 6.5% to 6.8% over the prior year, up from previous guidance of 5% to 6%
Full year adjusted diluted EPS of $8.91 to $8.96, up approximately 12% year-over-year at midpoint, up from previous guidance of $8.70 to $8.85
